system.description:
You work or study in a field of knowledge. You could be a school teacher, professor, researcher, or clergy member. The pursuit of knowledge is very important to you, and possibly what led you to become a hero.

Qualities

Assign a d12 and a d8 to two of these qualities:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.6pk4qELGNdf4aIC2]{Leadership}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.TvkPcxa7MKYW0DCL]{Self-Discipline}

• Select from Information qualities category

Principle

Choose an Expertise principle.

Power Source

Roll d10, d8 for power source selection.
